Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Business Intelligence Intern position at Gulf Coast Retail Group. I analyzed survey data using Python and Excel. I created Tableau dashboards for weekly reporting. My strongest tools are Python, SQL, Excel, Tableau, and I use them to keep analysis reproducible and reporting easy for a reader to follow. I would welcome the chance to bring that same care to your team, and I am eager to keep learning the tools your analysts rely on.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan
